title: 01_runtime_bars
interpretation: Wall-clock for the same SBML composite under the Python process-bigraph engine vs the Rust viva-core engine, at two simulated horizons. A single heavy libroadrunner process dominates, so the engine swap moves only framework overhead (within ~10%); the two engines produce bit-identical results (max abs diff 0.0 across all 9 observables).
